mentions.name: Personal photo storage engine
mentions.description: A personal photo storage engine backed by a SQLite database and Cloudflare R2, built with Actix Web, Tera, and Datastar and hosted on fly.io. It powers the photo galleries for the author's music site at crusty-metallian.net.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Finally, after at least 5 years of trying, I've figured out a photo storage engine for myself, backed by a SQLite database and Cloudflare R2.

https://metallian-photos.fly.dev
mentions.author: sentinel1909
